source.application: New rate applies to entire relevant contribution base; ordinary and special payments assessed separately.

scope: Full year standard ASVG, 12 ordinary and 2 equal special salaries, every payment rises by the stated monthly gross amount. Existing 2026 annual assessment; before payroll cent and assessment whole-euro rounding. No family/commuter/transfers/work expenses, behavioural or population effects.
policy_interpretation: Relative KV/PV/ALV cuts reduce but do not remove ALV notches while the stepped whole-base rate structure remains. No new smoothing reform is adopted here.
future_rule_warning: 2027 onward uses enacted transition rules already recorded under REV-ALV-DN. These 2026 thresholds and reduced rates must not be projected as future law.
